title: The Betti poset does not determine the Stanley projective dimension of a monomial ideal
description: Unrefereed research candidate. Two six-generated monomial ideals have isomorphic Betti posets over every field but Stanley projective dimensions three and two. A corrected nine-monomial analytic obstruction, explicit positive partitions and finite exhaustive checks support the separation. A census of all 7,443 five-atom lattices establishes that six generators are necessary. An explicit squarefree single-variable colon realization gives the separation in one ambient ring. Both example quotients have Stanley projective dimension five: the quotient assertion and the restricted simplicial-spanning-tree programme remain unresolved. Internal computational replay is not external peer review, unaffiliated reproduction or proof-assistant formal verification. Original prose and data are CC0-1.0; original code is MIT.
